Snorlax.name: Belly Drum
Snorlax.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Snorlax.description: Maxes its Attack in one turn, heals with its Sitrus Berry, then bulldozes through.

Darmanitan.name: Belly Drum
Darmanitan.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Darmanitan.description: Sheer Force and a maxed Attack: if it lands Belly Drum, little survives.

Clefable.name: Belly Drum
Clefable.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Clefable.description: Magic Guard means Life Orb costs it nothing: Belly Drum, heal, then hit hard.

Salamence.name: Mixed attacker
Salamence.label: Mixed attacker
Salamence.description: Splits its power between Draco Meteor and Outrage so neither kind of wall stops it.

Ferrothorn.name: Curse
Ferrothorn.label: Curse sweeper
Ferrothorn.description: Curse boosts on a slow, bulky body: its Gyro Ball and Power Whip only get stronger.

Metagross.name: Agility
Metagross.label: Agility sweeper
Metagross.description: Doubles its Speed with Agility, then sweeps with Life Orb Meteor Mash and Zen Headbutt.

Dusclops.name: Trick Room
Dusclops.label: Trick Room setter
Dusclops.description: Sets Trick Room so its slow teammates move first, and burns or chips anything in the way.
